pr_title: planner: change GETVAR('xxx') to constant if query doesn't contain SETVAR()
pr_body:
<!--
Thank you for contributing to TiDB! Please read TiDB's [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/pingcap/community/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document **BEFORE** filing this PR.
-->

### What problem does this PR solve? <!--add issue link with summary if exists-->
fixes https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/14231
This pr change GETVAR('xxx') to constant if query doesn't contain SETVAR() and conflicts it.

### What is changed and how it works?

In the process of predicate push down, check if there is SETVAR() for SELECTION. If not, change GETVAR('xxx') to constant.

```mysql
UPDATE store_order_time t, sync_boh_store_order_time b SET t.last_time=b.last_time
WHERE b.store_code = t.store_code AND b.biz_date = t.biz_date 
AND t.biz_date = @befor_day;
```

review_comments: `eliminateGetVar` is not clear to me. I prefer names like `convertGetVar2Constant`.
